title: DP-1 Extension Registry
description: Official registry of DP-1 protocol extensions

extensions.name: Channel Extension
extensions.description: Collaborative, persistent feeds of playlists with enhanced metadata and curation capabilities. Extends Playlist-Group with multi-curator support, publisher attribution, verifiable identities, and multi-signature roles including publisher. Conforming players verify feed and publisher signatures per the extension spec (rules are documented in prose, not enforced by the JSON Schema).
features: Publisher attribution for institutions and collectives
Multi-signature support (aligned with DP-1 v1.1.0), including `publisher` as a signature role alongside curator, feed, agent, institution, and licensor

Player verification: conforming implementations MUST verify at least one `feed` and one `publisher` signature before accepting a channel (specified in channel.md; JSON Schema validates structure and role enum only)

extensions.name: Playlist Extension
extensions.description: Extensions to DP-1 playlists for dynamic item fetching, enhanced metadata, and optional experimental Note (intermission) fields on the playlist and on each item. Enables playlists to transition from static collections to live, personalized feeds, plus inline carriage of the standardized Ref Manifest on items (inlineManifest).
features: Dynamic query for real-time item fetching from indexers
Curator metadata with DID-based verifiable identities
Fast start, rich upgrade rendering strategy
Experimental Note (intermission): optional short artist-authored text with optional display duration on the playlist and on each item; extension-only (allOf overlay), not canonical DP-1 core

Inline Manifest: a full Ref Manifest document carried on a PlaylistItem as inlineManifest — same schema and validation as a ref-fetched manifest, ref overrides inline, integrity via the playlist signature (no refHash needed)

changes: Playlist extension: optional inlineManifest on each PlaylistItem — a complete Ref Manifest document inline, validated by the unmodified ref-manifest schema; ref overrides inlineManifest when both are present; inline bytes are covered by the DP-1 playlist signature so no refHash is required.
Playlist extension: validated via the extension fragment and composed playlist schema (allOf); canonical core playlist.json unchanged; status remains draft extension v0.1.0.
Channel extension: `publisher` is a valid `signatures[].role` value in schema.json; registry description and features updated.
Channel extension: documented player norm—verify at least one `feed` and one `publisher` signature before treating a channel as valid; rule remains prose-only (not enforced by JSON Schema).

Playlist extension: optional experimental Note object on playlist and on each PlaylistItem (text required up to 500 characters; duration optional, default 20 seconds when omitted) for intermission-style screens between works.
Playlist extension: Note is validated only via the extension fragment and composed playlist schema (allOf); canonical core playlist.json unchanged.
Registry: Playlist Extension description and features list updated to document Note; status remains draft extension v0.1.0.
Playlist extension: document composed full-playlist validator at playlist_with_extension.json (allOf bundled core-compatible playlist + extension fragment).
Playlist extension: add bundles/playlist-core-v1.1.0.json so validation allows an empty items array when dynamicQuery is present, without changing the canonical core playlist schema.
Playlist extension: registry resources include composedPlaylistSchema pointing at the composed schema URL for implementers and SDKs.
